parameters.content: Set your direct PDF resume URL and complete job description. No private example CV or employer description is included.

## Setup

Download the source PDF to data, extract all pages and send complete resume text/job description to OpenAI. Configure OpenAI credentials. No Supabase storage exists in this workflow; it returns the report only.

## CV Screening with OpenAI

Original by [Mark Shcherbakov](https://www.linkedin.com/in/marklowcoding/) from [5minAI](https://www.skool.com/5minai-2861). Compare a PDF resume with job-related requirements. Return a matching percentage,summary and reasons for/against. Human review is required; no applicant selection/rejection is automated.

## Setup video

[Eight-minute original tutorial](https://youtu.be/TWuI3dOcn0E). Source notes mention Supabase storage,but no database node is present. No database write has been added.
Configure OpenAI credentials and available model. Source gpt-4o-mini default snapshot has announcedJanuary14,2027 shutdown; recheck your alias routing. Strict structured response; no workflow retry.
